title: Chaos injection suite: region failover, GPU pool exhaustion, and dependency blackholes
creator: Priya Nair
description: Objective: Build and run a repeatable chaos testing suite that injects three high-risk fault classes against our inference platform: (1) multi-region control-plane + data-plane loss (region outage and cross-region network partition), (2) GPU pool exhaustion in dedicated/Dedicated-like clusters (simulate full allocation and noisy-neighbor OOMs), and (3) dependency blackholes (datastore/time-series/metrics/third-party auth). The suite must validate automated failover, circuit-breaker behavior, load-shedding policies, SLO degradation thresholds, and runbook/responder actions.
acceptance_criteria: Automated test scenarios for each fault class implemented in the chaos pipeline and runnable on staging and a gated production canary namespace
Failure injection produces deterministic SLO deltas captured in dashboards: latency P95/P99, token-throughput, error-rate (5xx), and successful fallbacks invoked
Circuit breakers trip and recover per config: experiments verify backoff windows, manual overrides, and metric-driven state transitions
Load-shedding policies kick in under GPU saturation: lower-priority routes get 429s according to configured policy and high-priority routes preserve P99 latency targets
Runbook updated with steps for detection, mitigation, and post-mortem checklist; on-call team validated via tabletop exercise
No unmitigated customer-facing outage in gated production canary; automated rollback triggers verified for releases that cause regression beyond safe threshold
tasks: Design chaos scenarios matrix (region-loss, cross-region partition, full GPU allocation, GPU OOMs, datastore blackhole, metrics ingestion loss)
Integrate chaos tooling into CI: prototype with Chaos Mesh for k8s staging, Gremlin for dedicated clusters, and a lightweight fault injector for internal sim tests
Add instrumentation: new tags/spans to trace failover path, emit reasons for circuit-breaker state changes, expose GPU pool utilization metrics and queue lengths
Create dashboards and SLO-aware alerts: synthetic traffic generators, burn-rate calculators, and SLO regression graphs
Implement gating job that runs scenarios against canary namespace and blocks runtime release if SLO regression > 5% vs baseline
Update runbooks and run a live tabletop with on-call and PMs to validate procedures
Create post-test checklist to capture flaky components and assign follow-up ENG tickets
